in_marathi.name: Rakul
in_marathi.long_meaning: Rakul हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Rakul means 'Fortune' or 'Wealth' in Sanskrit and Telugu. This name is derived from the root word 'Raksha' which means 'to protect'. The name is believed to bring good fortune and wealth to the bearer.
